hook: Clement Delangue co-founded Hugging Face in 2016 with Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf, originally as a chatbot app, and steered it into the default home for sharing open-source AI models and datasets. Before that he worked in product management at Moodstocks, a computer vision startup that Google acquired the same year Hugging Face began. As CEO he built a platform that by September 2026 hosted more than 3 million models and 500,000 datasets used by more than 18 million developers. That same month he agreed to sell the company to Nvidia for roughly 12.9 billion dollars, negotiating to keep Hugging Face open across clouds, frameworks and chip vendors rather than tied to Nvidia's hardware alone.
name: Clement Delangue

quote.text: But for it to happen at a larger scale, it needs more compute, more support, more collaboration, and more visibility. That's why we went to talk to Jensen, who offered to do exactly that with us.
quote.context: Clement Delangue, quoted by TechCrunch on September 3, 2026, explaining Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face

quick_facts: Co-founder and CEO of Hugging Face, an open-source hub for AI models and datasets
Co-founded Hugging Face in 2016 with Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf
Previously worked in product management at Moodstocks, a computer-vision startup acquired by Google in 2016
Agreed to Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face for approximately 12.9 billion dollars, announced September 3, 2026
By the time of the Nvidia announcement, Hugging Face hosted more than 3 million models, 500,000 datasets and 1 million applications used by over 18 million developers

achievements.impact: Built an open-source hub that by September 2026 hosted more than 3 million AI models and 500,000 datasets used by over 18 million developers, per Nvidia's acquisition announcement.

achievements.title: Nvidia acquisition, 2026
achievements.impact: Led Hugging Face into an approximately 12.9 billion dollar acquisition by Nvidia, negotiating for the platform to remain open across clouds, frameworks and accelerators.

achievements.title: Pivoted Hugging Face from chatbot app to open-source hub
achievements.impact: Redirected the company from an open-domain conversational AI app toward hosting and sharing open-source machine learning models, forming the basis of today's platform.

achievements.title: Public voice for open-source AI
